Preserve his broad head 50 pixels wide and 42 high, broad short torso, ochre cloak, cream collar, tousled chestnut hair, belt, satchel and boots. Do NOT make him slimmer or turn front faces sideways. STRICT uniform FOUR columns THREE rows of equal SQUARE cells, landscape 4:3 sheet, transparent background, no text/grid/ground/shadow. Same body/head dimensions in all cells, feet baseline equal. Preserve the approved pixel clusters and brown tinted 1-2px outlines, warm top-left cream highlights and brown/violet shadows. NO teal.
